TEXT.1: Principal – The original amount of money borrowed.
TEXT.2: Interest – A fee charged by the lender for borrowing the money, usually a percentage of the principal.
TEXT.3: Repayment Term – The period over which the borrower agrees to pay back the loan.
TEXT.4: Installments – Regular payments (monthly, biweekly, etc.) made to repay the loan.
TEXT.5: Collateral (optional) – An asset pledged by the borrower (like a house or car) that the lender can take if the loan isn't repaid.
TEXT.DESCRIPTION: A loan is a sum of money that one party (usually a lender, like a bank or financial institution) gives to another party (the borrower) with the agreement that the money will be paid back over time, usually with interest..
